PLAN 11 | SHOTS 26-27 | AFTER THE TAKING
Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 2 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.
CHARACTER REFERENCES
CHAR_SHAHRNAZ = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
CHAR_ARNAVAZ = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
CHAR_ZAHHAK = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}
CHAR_GUARD_A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
CHAR_GUARD_B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
CHAR_GUARD_C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}
ANIMAL REFERENCES
ANIMAL_CAT = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL = {{LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL}}
PROP REFERENCES
PROP_STAFF = {{PROP_STAFF}}
PROP_BLADE = {{PROP_BLADE}}
START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_EMPTIED. Shadow extraction is complete. Shahrnaz still holds the cat at the left mark; Arnavaz stands at the right mark, dusty and lowered at her left shoulder. Guards remain behind and hands-off. The low ledge sits two short steps left of Shahrnaz; the blade rests at its near end. Zahhak stays supported by his right-hand staff.

SHOT 26 | 00:00-00:06 | WAITING INSIDE THE BODY
50mm near-still medium two-shot. The sisters remain in their last positions. Hold long enough to see breathing without purposeful response. Shahrnaz’s fingers are loose against the cat’s fur. Arnavaz stares in its direction through her fixed mask; only breathing moves her body.
SHOT 27 | 00:06-00:15 | CARE WITHOUT AFFECTION
Cut to 40mm side composition that includes Shahrnaz, the ledge and Arnavaz deeper right. Shahrnaz takes two short steps toward the ledge, supports the cat with both hands and sets it on the far half. The blade stays at the near end. She withdraws her hands without the earlier caress. The cat remains settled and looks toward her. End with her empty right hand hanging beside the visible handle.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
Preserve the reduced hall exposure and fixed rear-left light. A small existing reflected highlight makes the blade’s location readable. The cat keeps its ordinary small shadow.
SOUND
Six seconds of sparse breathing and hall air, then two soft footsteps, paws settling on stone and a sleeve withdrawing. Keep all gestures unvoiced.
END STATE AND EDIT
The cat sits alive on the far half of the ledge; blade remains flat at the near end, at least seventy centimeters from it. Shahrnaz stands beside the ledge with empty hands. Arnavaz watches from her original mark. Zahhak’s left hand is lowered.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

- PLAN 11 | SHOTS 26A–26C | THE HIDDEN BLADE

Create a 15-second cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9.
Three shots lasting four, seven and four seconds.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
Zahhak and his established shoulder serpents = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}

ANIMAL REFERENCE:
Cat = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

LOCATION REFERENCE:
Zahhak’s chamber = {{LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL}}

PROP REFERENCES:
Staff = {{PROP_STAFF}}
Blade = {{PROP_BLADE}}

The blade first becomes visible during this block.

START STATE:

The sisters remain under the fixed overhead spotlight:
Shahrnaz west, holding the cat.
Arnavaz east, her left shoulder lowered and clothing dusty.

Both initially face north.

Zahhak stands directly north of Arnavaz, facing south toward her. His right hand rests on his planted staff.

The blade is concealed in a fitted pocket beneath the rear-left layer of his outer garment.

SHOT 26A | 00:00–00:04 | FROM BENEATH THE GARMENT

65mm close view from WEST of Zahhak, aimed at his left hip and left hand.

His torso faces south toward Arnavaz, who remains outside this tight composition.

Zahhak reaches beneath the rear-left layer of his garment with his left hand. The fabric lifts enough to make the physical extraction clear.

He withdraws the single referenced blade, securely held by its handle. His right hand remains on the staff.

The blade crosses from peripheral darkness into the edge of the overhead light.

SHOT 26B | 00:04–00:11 | THE TRANSFER — ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE

50mm close medium shot from EAST of Arnavaz, looking WEST.

Arnavaz stands screen-left, facing screen-right.
Zahhak stands screen-right, facing screen-left.

Their opposing profiles, forearms and the entire blade remain visible.

Zahhak holds the blade low with its point angled toward the floor. His left fingers occupy the pommel end, leaving the main grip available.

Arnavaz extends her RIGHT hand and closes it around the exposed handle.

Hold the shared grip for one beat. Zahhak then opens his fingers and withdraws his left hand, completing the transfer visibly.

Arnavaz keeps the blade low beside her right thigh, tip directed toward the floor. Her left hand remains empty.

The camera makes one very small approach, preserving both hands throughout the transfer.

SHOT 26C | 00:11–00:15 | THE SISTERS TURN

Cut to a 40mm medium-wide view from NORTH of the sisters, looking SOUTH.

Shahrnaz appears screen-right.
Arnavaz appears screen-left.
Zahhak’s BACK occupies the left foreground, beside Arnavaz.

Zahhak steps backward toward the camera and clears the left edge of frame, withdrawing into the surrounding darkness.

Arnavaz turns her torso west toward Shahrnaz.
Shahrnaz turns east toward Arnavaz.

Their final screen relationship:
Arnavaz on screen-left faces screen-right.
Shahrnaz on screen-right faces screen-left.

They now face each other across seventy centimeters.
The cat remains against Shahrnaz’s chest.
The blade stays low in Arnavaz’s right hand.

LIGHT, PERFORMANCE AND SOUND:

Maintain the same overhead spotlight and near-black surroundings.

The sisters move with quiet, delayed obedience. Zahhak performs the transfer with economical certainty.

Sound: garment layers separating, a faint metal contact during extraction, fingers adjusting on the handle, staff-supported footsteps and steady breathing.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.
